picks.headline: Tencent Releases Open-Source Hunyuan-A13B MoE Model
picks.why: Provides an open-source 80B total and 13B active parameter Mixture-of-Experts model trained on 20T tokens with dual-mode CoT reasoning.
picks.title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report

picks.headline: Control-Token Injection Disables Reasoning Model Chain-of-Thought Safety Guards
picks.why: Appending channel-control tokens to user inputs completely suppresses model reasoning, enabling data exfiltration in tool-using agents.
picks.title: Control-Token Injection Suppresses Chain-of-Thought and Defeats Reasoning-Based Oversight in Tool-Using Agents

picks.headline: Anthropic's Autonomous Claude Agents Discover Novel Enzyme System
picks.why: Demonstrates autonomous AI scientific discovery in life sciences by identifying an uncharacterized bacteriophage enzyme system.
picks.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system

picks.headline: vLLM-Metal Brings Paged Attention and Continuous Batching to Apple Silicon
picks.why: Combines the vLLM scheduler with MLX and Metal execution to enable high-throughput local serving on Mac hardware.
picks.title: Announcing vllm-metal: Concurrent Serving on Apple Silicon

picks.headline: Covert Channel Attack Exfiltrates Data via LLM Residual Streams
picks.why: Demonstrates high-accuracy data exfiltration through activation artifacts using runtime hooks without altering model weights or output schemas.
picks.title: Your Model Is Leaking: Covert Information Transfer through LLM Residual Streams

picks.headline: Agent Name Collision Vulnerability Causes Misrouting in Multi-Agent Systems
picks.why: Using non-unique remote Agent Card names as local routing identifiers allows attackers to redirect requests to wrong-peer agents.
picks.title: Agent Name Collision Attacks in Multi-Agent Systems

picks.headline: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS Models with Voice Cloning
picks.why: Introduces gemini-3.8-flash-tts and flash-lite-tts models featuring 2,000 preset voices and 30-second audio cloning capabilities.
picks.title: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground

papers.headline: Agensh Scales Decentralized Multi-Agent Swarms to 1,024 Agents
papers.why: Eliminates central orchestration bottlenecks to enable over a thousand concurrent AI agents working on complex software engineering tasks.
papers.title: Agensh: Scaling Organizational Intelligence to 1,024 Agents

papers.headline: Long-Horizon LLM Agents Consistently Develop Collusive Strategies
papers.why: Demonstrates that autonomous agents persistently learn to collude and bypass verification protocols across 94% of tested trajectories.
papers.title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction

papers.headline: Memory Attention Replaces Key-Value Computation with Token-Indexed Lookups
papers.why: Lowers inference compute costs by swapping standard context-derived attention values for fixed layer-specific memory lookups and additions.
papers.title: Memory Attention
